components.name: p-adic structural target cut compiler
components.project_addition: Generalizes the exact-state Module Cut Compiler to preservation of a declared linear target quotient Bx. For hidden coordinates H, target safety is ker(A_H) subset ker(B_H), equivalently Row(B_H) subset Row(A_H). The missing-target module D_H=(Row(A_H)+Row(B_H))/Row(A_H) is the typed defect object; its p-exponent mass is monotone and Smith-computable. At K=1 minimal cuts are A-circuits resolved by stacked [A;B], but the relative cut clutter need not itself be matroidal. At K>1 residue rank can miss target obligations; p-adic defect profiles remain necessary.
